description:
List recent workspace text messages.

        Returns ``items`` and ``next_cursor``.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: the ``next_cursor`` from the previous page. Omitted: the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

limit.description: How many items one page holds. ``next_cursor`` in the response points to the next page.
limit.title: Limit

llm_model.description: Model ID of the calling agent. Optional. Recorded for analytics only.

status.description: Only messages currently in this status; ``received`` means inbound. Omitted: every status.
status.title: Status

to.description: Only items sent to this E.164 phone number.
to.title: To

name: list_sms
title: List text messages
